Historical [[Holotable]] composite of [[BoShek (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)|BoShek]], matching the later [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] publisher slip. The image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip; it is not an official printed full card.
